## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...' (`index.html` or `admin.html`)
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## 📸 Screenshots or Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots, screen recordings, or GIFs to help explain your problem.

## 🖥️ Environment & Device Info
- **Portal / Page:** [e.g. Participant Portal (`index.html`), Admin Dashboard (`admin.html`), or Apps Script Backend (`apps-script-backend.gs`)]
- **OS:** [e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Ubuntu, iOS, Android]
- **Browser:** [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge]
- **Browser Version:** [e.g. 120.0]

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. browser console errors, network response status codes).
